TextView.android:text: We want you to write us a review...or two, or three...

You may have heard (but just in case you didn't), we hit a real milestone: We've reached a billion reviews and contributions from our community of travelers. That's a billion reviews, tips, photos, likes, comments, and long-running forum posts that have made us all better and smarter travelers. And now? Well, we're hoping to get a billion more. So we're asking: Have you written a review? If not, maybe today's the day (it can can be about anything-a hotel, a restaurant, a destination, a cool thing to do...). And just in case you're wondering why you should write a review and and how to write a good one, we've got your back. To help you get started, here are answers to a few common questions.
So why should I write a review?

We're all about our community and look to you for the in-depth, been-there-done-that guidance -things like whether or not a hotel's bedsheets are too rough, the infinity pool is as dreamy as the photos, the views from the top of the mountain are worth the death-defying hike up, and so much more. You're the truth-teller and when you share the good, the bad, and the meh, it goes a long way toward helping another traveler plan their dream trip, Paying it forward is always a good thing.
